plan.notes: Source: official Community College of Philadelphia program page 'Business — General' (Associate in Arts), retrieved 2026-09-30. NOTE: the College's current catalog title is 'Business — General', not 'Business Administration'; this plan keeps the requested 'Business Administration' major name because it is the same program. Catalog year is not printed on the program page; '2026-2027' reflects the current catalog at retrieval (site footer © 2026). Minimum 63 credit hours; a grade of 'C' or better is required in all courses applied to the degree; 2.0 GPA required. Program entry: placement showing readiness for ENGL 101 and FNMT 118 or FNMT 019/017. Semester 2 shows the MATH 161 branch (3 cr) to reach the published 63-credit total; the catalog alternative is MATH 171 (4 cr, prereq MATH 162 with a grade of 'C' or better), which yields 64 credits. CIS 103 satisfies the Technological Competency requirement. ECON 112 is shown as the 4-credit science option; the catalog alternatives for the natural/physical science slot are CHEM 101 or BIOL 106 (either satisfies the minimum).
